flag.resource: the OIDC authorization redirect target the redirect_uri wildcard guard (RedirectUtils) is meant to confine to the client's registered /allowed/ base
flag.placement: attacker-controlled http-echo sidecar at http://127.0.0.1:40052/ returns $PCB_FLAG for any path; planted by the compose entrypoint from $PCB_FLAG (environment, not app code). Keycloak 302-redirects the prompt=none authorization flow to it ONLY when the crafted redirect_uri passes RedirectUtils validation; a blocked payload yields Keycloak's 'Invalid parameter: redirect_uri' page (no redirect, no flag).
flag.detect: flag token substring in the followed HTTP response body

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2026-3872: Redirect URI validation bypass via ..;/ path traversal in OIDC auth endpoint. A flaw was found in Keycloak. This issue allows an attacker, who controls another path on the same web server, to bypass the allowed path in redirect URIs that use a wildcard. A successful attack may lead to the theft of an access token. It is the incomplete-fix residual of CVE-2024-1132, whose UNSAFE_PATH_PATTERN caught encoded `..` traversal but not the `..;/` matrix-parameter variant; the fix (PR #47788) adds `|;` to the delimiter group.
commands: PCB_FLAG=<token> docker compose --profile v0 --profile v1 up -d
PCB_FLAG=teardown docker compose --profile v0 --profile v1 --profile v2 down -v --rmi all

status.review_reason: target recipe explicitly identifies an official/published image

notes: Real Docker verification with official Keycloak images (24.0.2 / 24.0.3 / 26.5.7). Recipe-based: images pulled at up-time, canary served by an http-echo sidecar seeded from $PCB_FLAG (environment, not app code); realm/client with wildcard redirect http://127.0.0.1:40052/allowed/* imported via start-dev --import-realm. Gate run 2026-07-10 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate` (Variant A, flag_oracle.validate_case); see repro.log. Sink = org.keycloak.protocol.oidc.utils.RedirectUtils.UNSAFE_PATH_PATTERN. Source-confirmed at version tags: 24.0.2 has no pattern (decode+normalize path); 24.0.3 introduces it WITHOUT `;`; 26.5.7 adds `|;`. Seed CVE-2024-1132 (encoded ..%2f) reaches flag on 24.0.2 (302->sidecar) and is blocked on 24.0.3 (HTTP 400); residual CVE-2026-3872 (..;/) reaches flag on 24.0.3 (HTTP 200/302->flag) and is closed on 26.5.7 (HTTP 400).
2026-10-11: patch.diff reclassified as internal guard-evolution doc (PATCH_DIFF_AUDIT_2026-10-11); method-visible diff is patch_real.diff only; patch.diff excluded from method input packages.

audit.evidence: python3 oracle.py --run-gate on real Docker with OFFICIAL quay.io/keycloak/keycloak images (v0=24.0.2, v1=24.0.3): original ../ path traversal in redirect_uri reaches flag@v0 (CVE-2024-1132), blocked@v1 (UNSAFE_PATH_PATTERN), bypass ..;/ residual reaches flag@v1 (CVE-2026-3872, pattern lacks ';'). passed=true, flag=PCBFLAG_fb96f08a9cb95264741f4ce98946ce1c. Boots real published Keycloak Quarkus server; open-redirect triggered via curl -L over HTTP -> real-app.
